title: probe-suite-for-batch-cache-profiles-and-regression-thresholds
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a modular probe/eval suite that validates quality preservation when applying automatically recommended batching and KV-cache profiles. The suite will drive safe automated apply/rollback paths for the autotune service by producing statistically supported pass/fail signals and human-review queues for borderline cases. Unlike prior golden-prompt artifacts, this ticket focuses on a pluggable probe design that supports multiple customer workloads, multi-metric scoring, and configurable acceptance thresholds per profile.
background: Autotune recommends batching and KV cache profiles that reduce token cost and increase throughput. We have several incidents where tuning cut costs but produced subtle semantic regressions in open-ended outputs or hallucination increases for specific prompt families. Current acceptance is ad-hoc; we need a repeatable, auditable probe harness that gates automated config application and supports progressive rollout plans.
goals: 1) Provide a reusable probe corpus builder that can ingest customer prompt sketches and generate diversified probes. 2) Run multi-metric evals (semantic similarity, factuality heuristics, and intent-preservation classifiers) against a stable reference to produce a single pass/fail decision plus a graded confidence. 3) Define statistical thresholds and sample sizes for automated apply and for canary escalation. 4) Integrate with the autotune pipeline to trigger automatic rollback on detected regressions.
out_of_scope: Creating new human-in-the-loop labeling infra (we will integrate existing human-review queues), expanding to embeddings-only workloads (separate ticket), and providing per-customer bespoke probes beyond templated ingestion.
acceptance_criteria: 1) The probe harness runs end-to-end in CI and produces a reproducible report for a given batch/cache profile. 2) For three representative workloads (chat-assistant, summarization, lookup-based Q&A) the system can detect seeded regressions with >= 90% recall at <= 5% false-positive rate using defined thresholds. 3) The autotune runner consumes the pass/fail signal and will not apply a profile that fails the probe. 4) On a failing canary, autotune will auto-rollback and create a ticket with the eval report attached.
technical_design:
- Modular probe pipeline: (1) corpus ingestion and augmentation, (2) reference capture (golden responses), (3) metric suite (embedding-similarity via SBERT, answer-exactness for lookup tasks, truthiness heuristics, and token-level distribution deltas), (4) statistical aggregator that computes paired metrics and confidence intervals.
- Support for plug-in metrics: each metric outputs a numeric score and a calibration function.
- Decision engine: uses weighted scoring + significance tests (Wilcoxon signed-rank for non-normal distributions, bootstrap CI for semantic-similarity) to produce PASS/WARN/FAIL and confidence score.
- Report format: JSON + human-readable HTML that includes diffed responses, metric time-series, and links to failing probes.
- Integration: expose a small REST endpoint consumed by autotune when running candidate profiles; include a dry-run mode for shadowing.
test_plan:
1) Unit tests for each metric and the aggregator. 2) Synthetic regression injection: modify reference responses to create controlled semantic shifts; verify detection rates. 3) End-to-end CI job that runs candidate profile against three workload templates with required sample sizes (see statistical appendix). 4) Small-scale canary in dedicated environment (10% of requests) with manual review on WARN. 5) Human spot-check: sample 50 failing probes and confirm human-verified regression rate. 6) Performance budget: eval run must complete within 10 minutes for 200 probes on a standard CI instance.
Statistical details: default alpha=0.01 for high-impact profiles, alpha=0.05 for low-impact; minimum N=100 paired probes for automated apply unless metric variance permits smaller N via bootstrap.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: internal shadow runs (2 weeks) across nightly jobs. Phase 1: wire to autotune in dry-run for non-production profiles (1 week). Phase 2: canary auto-apply for low-risk profiles with 10% traffic and human-review on WARN (2 weeks). Phase 3: full auto-apply with auto-rollback on FAIL and alerting (1 week). Rollback policy: immediate rollback when FAIL with confidence >= 95% or when WARN persists in two consecutive runs.
monitoring_and_alerting: Create dashboard: probe pass rate, per-metric deltas, number of auto-rollbacks, mean time to rollback. Alerts: P0 if pass rate < 95% for production profiles for 10m; P1 if number of WARNs exceeds historical baseline by > 3 sigma in 1h. Attach run IDs to autotune change events for traceability.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: false positives block beneficial cost saves. Mitigation: conservative thresholds, human-review path for WARN, allow opt-in override with audit trail. Risk: synthetic probes do not reflect customer prompts. Mitigation: corpus ingestion to accept customer sketch and sample live prompts for customers with opt-in. Risk: eval runtime adds latency to apply path. Mitigation: fast-mode with smaller N and async post-apply verification for low-risk profiles.
deliverables: 1) Probe harness service and CLI. 2) Reference corpora templates for three workload classes. 3) Metric implementations and calibration scripts. 4) Autotune integration PR + playbook for operators. 5) Dashboards and alerts. 6) Runbook for manual escalation and human-review steps.
